summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing share buybacks and option exercises. The issuer repurchased approximately 11.9 million shares for cancellation between March 20 and April 13, 2026, at prices ranging from ~$6.57 to $6.82 per share. Additionally, 2,200 new shares were issued upon exercise of share options at $0.50 per share. Total outstanding shares increased to 840,416,267. The disclosure serves as a routine update under HK listing rules. The buyback represents a capital return event. Watch for future buyback cadence and potential impact on EPS.
